\newcommand{\PrimaryDetailedFindingText}{Cases had higher average values on all four primary measures (Coauthor-citation rate 0.045, 95\% bootstrap CI [0.039, 0.050]; Reciprocity 0.129, 95\% bootstrap CI [0.089, 0.170]; Local clustering 0.026, 95\% bootstrap CI [0.021, 0.031]; Outgoing HHI 0.097, 95\% bootstrap CI [0.091, 0.102]).
